description: This file defines a custom exception class 'PlatformInternalServerException' for handling unexpected server errors in the Fineract project. It extends 'AbstractPlatformException' and is part of the 'org.apache.fineract.infrastructure.core.exception' package.

classes.name: PlatformInternalServerException
classes.description: A custom runtime exception for internal server errors within the Fineract platform, providing constructors that pass messages and arguments to its superclass.

methods.name: PlatformInternalServerException
methods.description: Constructor that creates a new instance with specified localization and user messages, passing them to the superclass.
